source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 31 exercise hal (PDF 230-231): MCQs wajah ke saath, short, constructed aur descriptive jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 31 (Materials and Energy) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I) A mining engineer discovers a new deposit of a metal that occurs primarily as a carbonate. Which sequence is most efficient for the extraction of metals?
(Aik dhaat (metal) zyada tar carbonate ki shakal mein milti hai. Is ko nikalne ki sab se behtar tarteeb kaun si hai?)

options.text: Mining, Concentration, Roasting, Reduction with Carbon

blocks.explanation: Carbonate ore ko calcination (kam ya bila hawa garam karna) se oxide banate hain, maslan ZnCO₃ → ZnO + CO₂; phir oxide ko reduce karte hain. Roasting sulphide ores ke liye hai (31.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
II) he extraction of aluminium from its oxide is done by electrolysis and not by calcination because:
(Aluminium ko us ke oxide se electrolysis se kyun nikalte hain, carbon se kyun nahi?)

options.text: Aluminium is more reactive than carbon

blocks.explanation: Aluminium reactivity series mein carbon se ooper hai, is liye carbon Al₂O₃ ko reduce nahi kar sakta. Bohat reactive dhaatein (Na, K, Al) electrolysis se nikalti hain (31.1.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein “he extraction” chhapa hai, pehla harf ghaib: “The extraction”. Aur muqabla carbon se reduction ke saath hai (calcination sirf carbonate ko oxide banati hai, oxide se dhaat nahi nikalti).

blocks.prompt:
III) Which property makes ceramics suitable for furnace bricks?
(Ceramics ki kaun si khasiyat inhein furnace bricks ke liye mozoon banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ceramics bohat zyada temperature par bhi thos rehte hain, is liye steel furnaces ki andar ki tah (refractory bricks) mein lagte hain (Table 31.2).

blocks.prompt:
IV) In fiberglass, the matrix mainly:
(Fibreglass mein matrix ka asal kaam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Composite mein matrix reinforcement ko thaam kar rakhta hai, jabke reinforcement (glass ya carbon fibres) mazbooti deta hai (31.1.4).

blocks.prompt:
V) Major limitation of mechanical recycling is:
(Mechanical recycling ki bari kamzori kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mechanical recycling (chhaantna, saaf karna, pighlana, nayi shakal) contamination aur polymer chains ke toot-ne (degradation) se mehdood hai (Table 31.3). Monomers chemical recycling mein bante hain; Na₂CO₃ kaghaz ke liye hai.

blocks.prompt:
VI) The mobile phone recycling is difficult because of:
(Mobile phone ki recycling mushkil kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mobile phones aur laptops mile jule materials (maslan dhaat par plastic ki tah) se bante hain jo aasani se alag nahi hote: material separation ka masla (31.2.3).

blocks.prompt:
VII) Chemicals from coal used in dyes are:
(Coal se milne wale kaun se chemicals dyes mein istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Coal ka bara petrochemical istemal benzene, toluene aur xylene hasil karna hai, jo dyes, resins aur explosives ke liye zaroori hain (31.4).

blocks.prompt:
VIII) Nuclear fission involves:
(Nuclear fission mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fission mein bhaari nucleus (maslan ²³⁵U) do halke nuclei mein toot-ta hai aur energy aur neutrons nikalte hain; halke nuclei ka judna fusion hai (31.8).

blocks.prompt:
a) What is a chain reaction in nuclear fission?
Nuclear fission mein chain reaction kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
²³⁵U ki har fission energy aur taqreeban teen neutrons kharij karti hai:
²³⁵U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴¹Ba + ⁹²Kr + 3n + energy
Yeh neutrons mazeed ²³⁵U nuclei torte hain jo aur neutrons dete hain, is tarah fission khud chalta rehta hai: chain reaction.

blocks.prompt:
b) State the economic challenge associated with reprocessing waste materials.
Waste ki reprocessing ka maashi (economic) masla bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Reprocessing mein chhaantna, saaf karna waghera aur bohat energy lagti hai, is liye yeh mehngi hai. Jab wahi material kahin aur sasta mil jaye to yeh ghair maashi (uneconomical) ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) Keeping in view the concept of microstructure, explain why adding zinc to copper (to form Brass) results in a material that is stronger than pure copper.
Microstructure ke hawale se batayein ke copper mein zinc mila kar bana brass khalis copper se zyada mazboot kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Alloy banana dhaat ka microstructure (andar ki banawat) badal deta hai. Mukhtalif size ke zinc atoms copper atoms ke darmiyan baith kar baqaida tahon ko bigaar dete hain, is liye tahen aasani se aik doosre par phisal nahi saktin. Is liye brass (Cu 60–90 %, Zn 10–40 %) khalis copper se zyada mazboot aur zang se mehfooz hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Khalis dhaat mein sab atoms aik size ke hote hain aur tahen (layers) aasani se phisalti hain, is liye dhaat naram hoti hai. Alag size ka atom in tahon ko 'atka' deta hai; yeh wajah layers ke phisalne ki misal se samjhayi gayi hai (chapter sirf itna kehta hai ke alloying microstructure badal kar strength barhati hai).

blocks.prompt:
d) Define energy density and give one example.
Energy density ki tareef karein aur aik misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Energy density fuel ke fi unit volume mein mojood energy hai, aam tor par MJ/L mein. Misal: diesel, taqreeban 35.8 MJ/L, gasoline (taqreeban 34.2 MJ/L) se zyada energy dense hai.

blocks.prompt:
e) Name two specific semiconductors mentioned in the text and their modern applications.
Text mein diye gaye do semiconductors aur un ke jadeed istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Silicon (Si): microchips, solar panels aur SIM cards.
2. Gallium arsenide (GaAs): wireless communication, maslan 5G internet devices.
(Gallium nitride, GaN, bhi: electric cars ki tez charging.)

blocks.prompt:
f) State two applications of X-ray crystallography in science or industry.
X-ray crystallography ke do istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Biomolecules ki banawat maloom karna: DNA double helix, enzymes aur proteins.
2. Dawa (drug) banana: dekhna ke drug molecule apne target se kaise judta hai. (Minerals, synthetic crystals aur nanomaterials ka tajziya bhi.)

blocks.prompt:
g) State two advantages and one disadvantage of nuclear fission.
Nuclear fission ke do faide aur aik nuqsan batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Faide: 1. Thore se fuel se bohat zyada energy. 2. Nuclear power plants mein fossil fuel jalaye baghair bari miqdar mein bijli.
Nuqsan: radioactive waste jise lambe arse tak sambhalna parta hai (aur hadsaat ka khatra, maslan Chernobyl 1986, Fukushima 2011).

blocks.prompt:
h) In the reduction of Hematite (Fe₂O₃), carbon is added, but carbon monoxide (CO) is the actual species that displaces the oxygen. Explain why the gas (CO) is a more efficient reducing agent in a large-scale furnace than solid carbon (C).
C + ½O₂ → CO
Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂
Hematite ki reduction mein carbon dala jata hai magar oxygen CO hatata hai. Bari furnace mein gas CO thos carbon se behtar reducing agent kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: CO gas hai, is liye poori furnace mein phail kar ore ke har tukre tak, us ke suraakhon (pores) ke andar tak, pohanchti hai aur Fe₂O₃ se poora rabta banati hai. Thos carbon thos ore ko sirf chand jagahon par chhoota hai, is liye thos–thos reaction sust hai. Is liye CO ore ko tez aur zyada mukammal reduce karti hai: Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂.

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar jawab)

blocks.prompt:
a) Explain environmental problem, caused by fossil fuels.
Fossil fuels se paida hone wale mahauliyati (environmental) masail bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Fossil fuels (petroleum, coal, natural gas) jalne se CO₂ jaisi greenhouse gases banti hain.
1. Greenhouse gases garmi rok leti hain, jis se global warming aur climate change hota hai.
2. Jalne se hawa mein aaloodgi (pollutants) jaati hai, yani air pollution.
3. Fossil fuels dobara nahi bante (non-renewable); zyada istemal se energy ki kami aur mehngai hoti hai, is liye renewable zaraye (solar, hydro, wind) chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
b) Based on the chemical equations provided, explain why roasting sulphide ores poses a greater environmental challenge compared to the calcination of carbonate ores.
Chemical equations ki buniyad par batayein ke sulphide ores ki roasting carbonate ores ki calcination se zyada mahauliyati masla kyun hai?
blocks.explanation:
Roasting (zyada hawa): 2ZnS(s) + 3O₂(g) → 2ZnO(s) + 2SO₂(g)
Calcination (kam ya bila hawa): ZnCO₃(s) → ZnO(s) + CO₂(g)
Roasting sulphur dioxide, SO₂, kharij karti hai jo zehreeli aur tezabi gas hai; hawa mein sulphuric acid bana kar acid rain laati hai jo faslon, mitti, jheelon aur imaraton ko nuqsan deti hai. Calcination CO₂ deti hai jo greenhouse gas hai magar zehreeli ya tez tezabi nahi. Is liye roasting zyada bara mahauliyati masla hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sawal 'chemical equations provided' kehta hai magar sawal ke saath equations nahi chhapi; yahan chapter (31.1.1) ki roasting aur calcination wali equations istemal ki gayi hain. Acid rain ki tafseel chapter 32 mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) If a sample of copper is 98% pure after reduction, why is the final "refining" step still considered crucial for the manufacturing of electrical wiring?
Agar copper reduction ke baad 98% khalis ho, to bijli ki taaron ke liye aakhri refining kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Copper bijli ki taaron mein apni bohat zyada conductivity (bijli guzarne ki salahiyat) ki wajah se lagta hai, aur wiring ke liye taqreeban 99.99 % khalis copper chahiye. 2 % mailapan (impurities) conductivity kam (resistance zyada) kar deta hai, is liye taarein energy ko garmi bana kar zaya karti. Refining (maslan electrolytic refining) yeh impurities nikal kar 99.99 % copper deti hai.

blocks.prompt:
d) Explain, why chemical recycling (depolymerization) is often superior to mechanical recycling?
Chemical recycling (depolymerization) aksar mechanical recycling se behtar kyun hai?
blocks.explanation:
Mechanical recycling sirf plastic ko chhaantti, saaf karti, pighlati aur nayi shakal deti hai, is liye rang (dyes) aur doosri milawat us mein reh jati hai aur polymer chains toot jaati hain; har dafa quality girti hai aur milawat wala plastic khane ke liye istemal nahi ho sakta.
Chemical recycling heat, solvents ya catalysts se polymer chains ko wapas asal monomers ya saada chemicals mein tor deti hai. Yeh zyada khalis reactants hain, in se asal quality ka naya polymer ban sakta hai, aur milawat wale ya mile jule plastics bhi recycle ho sakte hain.

rows: Chhaantna, saaf karna, pighlana, nayi shakal
Polymer chains ko monomers ya saada chemicals mein torna
Milawat product mein reh jati hai
Chains toot-ti hain; har dafa quality girti hai
Asal quality ka naya polymer ban sakta hai

blocks.prompt:
e) Gold is often found in its free state, while sodium is only found in the combined states. Use the concept of the reactivity series to justify why the extraction process for sodium is significantly more energy-intensive than for gold.
Gold aazad halat mein milta hai jabke sodium sirf compounds mein. Reactivity series ki madad se batayein ke sodium nikalne mein gold se kahin zyada energy kyun lagti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Gold reactivity series mein bohat neeche hai: yeh mushkil se compounds banata hai, is liye aazad (metallic) halat mein milta hai aur sirf mining aur concentration chahiye, chemical reduction nahi.
Sodium reactivity series mein bohat ooper (carbon se bhi ooper) hai: foran react karta hai aur sirf NaCl jaise compounds mein milta hai jin ke bonds bohat mustahkam hain. Carbon sodium compounds ko reduce nahi kar sakta, is liye sodium pighle hue compound ki electrolysis se nikalta hai. Is mein bohat energy lagti hai, pehle compound pighlane mein aur phir bari bijli guzarne mein (cathode par Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na). Is liye sodium nikalna kahin zyada energy mangta hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Explain composite materials by describing and differentiating the roles of the matrix and the reinforcement in them.
Composite materials ko matrix aur reinforcement ke kirdar bayan kar ke aur un mein farq kar ke samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Composite do ya zyada materials ka aisa milaap hai jo akele har hisse se behtar khasiyat wala product banata hai.
Matrix: asal, phaila hua hissa jis mein doosra material qaid hota hai. Yeh reinforcement ko jagah par thaamta, jorta, shakal deta aur bojh us tak pohanchata hai. Fibreglass mein matrix polymer hai.
Reinforcement agent: matrix ke andar band material, maslan kapre, glass ya carbon ke fibres. Yeh material ko bohat mazbooti deta hai. Aik composite mein aik se zyada reinforcement agents ho sakte hain.
Khasiyat: composites ka strength-to-weight ratio (wazan ke muqable mazbooti) achha aur zang (corrosion) ke khilaf mazboot muzahimat, is liye mushkil kaamon ke liye mozoon.
Misalein: fibreglass (polymer + glass fibres) kashtiyon ke dhaanche, gaariyon ki body aur deewaron/chhaton ki insulation mein; carbon fibre jahazon aur khel ke saman mein kyunke halka aur bohat paedaar hai.

rows: Reinforcement ko thaamta, jorta, shakal deta hai
Aik se zyada reinforcement ho sakte hain
Fibreglass: glass fibres; ya kapra, carbon fibres

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Explain how X-rays interact with crystals to produce diffraction patterns and how these patterns help determine atomic positions.
X-rays crystals se mil kar diffraction pattern kaise banati hain aur yeh pattern atoms ki jagah maloom karne mein kaise madad deta hai?
blocks.explanation:
X-ray crystallography crystalline thos mein atoms ki teen-dimensional jagah maloom karti hai.
1. X-rays kyun: X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti, atoms ke darmiyani faasle jitni, hai, is liye yeh atoms aur electrons ki jagah dhoond sakti hain. Crystal atoms ki baqaida tahon (layers) se bana hota hai.
2. Amal: source se aati X-rays crystal par par kar atoms (un ke electrons) se takrati hain aur khaas angles par diffract (mur) hoti hain (Figure 31.4).
3. Path difference: d faasle wali do padosi tahon se θ angle par lautne wali shuaayein mukhtalif faasla tay karti hain; izafi raasta 2d sin θ hai. Sirf un angles par jahan lehrein aik doosre ko mazboot karein (2d sin θ poori wavelengths ke barabar, Bragg's law (chapter se aage)) tez diffracted shuaayein nikalti hain.
4. Diffraction pattern: yeh shuaayein screen (detector) par dhabbon (spots) ka pattern banati hain.
5. Atoms ki jagah: spots ki jagah aur shiddat atoms ki tarteeb par munhasir hai. Riyazi (mathematical) models se pattern ko electron-density map mein badla jata hai (jaise naphthalene, Figure 31.5). Electron density ki chotiyan atoms ki jagah batati hain, jis se atoms ke faasle, bond lengths aur bond angles, yani molecule ya crystal ka poora structure milta hai.
Istemal: DNA double helix, enzymes aur proteins, drug design, minerals aur nanomaterials.

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Describe the main steps involved in the extraction of metals from their ores.
Ores se dhaatein nikalne ke ahem marahil bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Metallurgy dhaaton ko ores se nikal kar khalis karne ka ilm hai. Reactive dhaatein ores ki shakal mein milti hain (dhaat ka compound + mitti wali milawat, jise gangue kehte hain). Ahem marahil:
i. Mining: zameen mein dabi ore nikalna, maslan iron ke liye haematite (Fe₂O₃).
ii. Ore concentration: ore se zyada se zyada milawat (gangue) door karna.
iii. Concentrated ore ko metal oxide banana:
Roasting (sulphide ores, zyada hawa mein garam): 2ZnS(s) + 3O₂(g) → 2ZnO(s) + 2SO₂(g)
Calcination (carbonate ores, kam ya bila hawa garam): ZnCO₃(s) → ZnO(s) + CO₂(g)
iv. Oxide ki dhaat mein reduction (sab se ahem qadam), reactivity ke mutabiq:
Carbon se neeche wali dhaatein: carbon reducing agent; pehle CO banta hai jo oxygen hatata hai:
C + ½O₂ → CO
Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂
Carbon se ooper wali (Na, K, Al): pighle compound ki electrolysis; metal ions cathode par ja kar electrons le kar dhaat bante hain. Bohat energy lagti hai.
v. Refining: thermal, chemical ya electrochemical tareeqon se dhaat khalis karna, maslan wiring ke liye copper 99.99 %.
vi. Alloying (zaroorat par): doosri dhaaton ya non-metals ke saath mila kar mazbooti, zang se bachao waghera behtar karna, maslan brass, bronze, steel, duralumin.
